description: Defines data structures and a class for managing XNAP UE contexts, including lookup, addition, removal, and ID allocation functionalities within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

classes.name: xnap_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a list of UE contexts, providing methods for lookup, addition, removal, updating, and ID allocation.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE with a given XNAP UE ID or UE index exists.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses the UE context by XNAP UE ID or UE index.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds and returns a pointer to the UE context by XNAP UE ID, or nullptr if not found.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context with specified UE index and XNAP UE ID.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Updates the UE index for an existing UE context.

methods.name: remove_ue_context
methods.description: Removes a UE context by UE index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UE contexts managed.

methods.name: allocate_xnap_ue_id
methods.description: Allocates and returns the next available XNAP UE ID.
